contract: KAN-255 + Product ADR-011 + STARTERIA_DESIGN_SYSTEM_CONTRACT_v0.1 + STARTERIA_PAGE_ANATOMY_SYSTEM_v0.1; one four-stage demo, Team/Fab execution split, no Portfolio Entry link, configured commercial CTA, responsive and accessible at all contracted viewports.

accessibility.evidence: Semantic landmarks and heading order inspected; roving tabs exercised by keyboard; skip link and focus visibility verified; controls have accessible names; reduced-motion disables landing animations; Lighthouse accessibility audit recorded in the delivery report.

responsive.evidence: Playwright rendered 390x844, 768x900, 1024x900 and 1440x900; every viewport passed the horizontal-overflow assertion and full-page visual review.

loading.reason: The public landing renders static local content and performs no data-loading operation.

empty.reason: The approved landing has no user-owned collection or empty data state.

error.reason: No request or mutation is made within the landing; external destinations remain ordinary links.

partial.reason: All narrative content is shipped together in the frontend bundle and has no partial-data mode.

success.evidence: Selecting any of the four stages updates one labelled tabpanel and leaves a clear next stage or commercial action.

permission.reason: The public landing is unauthenticated and exposes no permission-gated action; sign-in remains a separate route.

renderedEvidence.observation: Single-column hero, vertical transformation, 2x2 tabs, Team/Fab routes and compact comparison fit without horizontal overflow.
Tablet layout preserves hierarchy, touch targets, connected transformation and readable product demo.
Compact desktop keeps the transformation and story canvas balanced with no clipped labels.
Wide desktop establishes the approved editorial hierarchy and one connected product narrative.
